To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
for Cairenes Arabic, the internal structure of words in terms of foot structure determines prosodic processing and this structure effect is complementted by a frequency effect.
the internal prosodic structure of words in Cairene Arabi is processed in an early stage of word stress perception, while predictability of stress is reflected in later ERP components.
the processing of stress in Cairene is determined by both the predictability of stress, and the metrical structure of the language.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of predictability in word stress processing and the question of whether the internal prosodic structure of words is processed in the brain.
the question how stress systems are processed and what the role of predictability of stress is.
the interaction of predictability and structural properties in word stress processing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

predictability of stress is reflected in the processing of stress only indirectly, namely via the internal structure of words, and that the internal word structure of Cairene Arabic plays an important role for stress processing.
the internal prosodic structure is the main determining factor in the prosodic word stress processing of Cairene Arabic.
predictability of word stress in the sense of a stress default rule is not reflected in the ERP data.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the internal structure of the word is crucial for the prosodic processing, but that the predictability of stress also has an influence.
the internal prosodic structure of the word, in terms of feet, plays the most crucial role in stress perception.
the processing of stress is based on the internal structure of words.
The main takeaway from our work is that
predictability of stress does not play a major role in stress processing in a regular stress system.
the processing of stress is determined by the predictability and structure of stress systems, which are language-specific properties.
the predictability of stress placement in a language is a crucial factor for the prosodic processing, which can be reflected in a frequency effect.
